sentences.text: For a UCB case covered by the residual clause, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB, and for term loans any levied charge is to be based on the amount being prepaid.
The evidence provided does not include the approved policy for the gold loan, so the exact charge to mention in the gold loan FAQ is not supported from the record.
The loan agreements in the record conflict on the amount, with one stating 2% of principal outstanding and another stating 3% of principal outstanding for foreclosure or pre-payment.
The evidence also shows that the RBI directions on pre-payment charges were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on the as-of date.
